headline: LIONESS-PANDA gives one network per sample and also the cohort network; PANDA alone gives only the cohort network.
points: Needs: expression matrix, motif prior, PPI network.

choices.question: Do you need one network per sample, or only the cohort network?

options.label: One network per sample (LIONESS-PANDA)
options.description: Lets you compare samples, or relate them to outcomes such as survival · Also writes the cohort network · Slower: it reruns PANDA once per sample

options.label: Cohort network only (PANDA)
options.description: A single PANDA run, so faster · It will not show how samples differ
